description.zh: 声音是介质里疏密的传播：波长 λ = v/f，v = fλ 连起周期与波长；两个相近频率叠加产生拍；谐波的强弱决定音色；用声速估算雷电距离；可听声、次声与超声的频率范围。一维线性无损耗模型，本页不播放声音，只画波形。
description.en: Sound is a squeeze-and-loosen pattern travelling in a medium: wavelength λ = v/f and v = fλ link period and wavelength; two close frequencies add into beats; harmonic strengths set timbre; the speed of sound estimates thunder distance; and the frequency bands of audible, infra- and ultrasound. A one-dimensional linear lossless model; this page plays no sound and only draws waveforms.

reason.zh: 第 2 步把两个相近频率的声波相加，得到按 |f₁−f₂| 起伏的包络，是叠加原理的直接应用。
reason.en: Step 2 adds two sound waves of close frequency and gets an envelope swelling at |f₁−f₂|, a direct use of superposition.

label.en: Timbre is a sum of harmonics

reason.zh: 第 3 步用 n 倍频的正弦波按不同强度叠加得到各种波形，是傅里叶“任何周期波形都是正弦之和”的直观例子。
reason.en: Step 3 builds waveforms from sine waves at multiples of one frequency with different strengths, a hands-on case of Fourier’s “any periodic wave is a sum of sines”.

title.zh: 同一个音，为什么钢琴和小提琴听起来不同？
title.en: Why does the same note sound different on a piano and a violin?
